caption: The worked example on the top-left 2×2 window. Correlation with the mask as written gives 37 at pixel (0,0); convolution with the flipped mask (corners 1 and 4 swap) gives 23 at pixel (1,1), because the anchor moves to the bottom-right cell.

spec.title: Correlation vs convolution on a 2×2 window
spec.aria: A five-row table compares the 2 by 2 window 1, 2, 4, 5 with the mask 1, 2, 3, 4 and its 180-degree flip 4, 3, 2, 1; the correlation products 1, 4, 12, 20 sum to 37, and the convolution products 4, 6, 8, 5 sum to 23.
